run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-17T19:28:51Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert for otel-demo/frontend is explained by a configuration error in the shipping Deployment. frontend error-status spans were 0 in every sampled minute from 18:30:51 to 19:27:51 and then rose to ~0.7-2.1 spans/s from 19:28:51, the alert's start time; the error-bearing frontend spans are POST /api/checkout, 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' and the grpc client span oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (http.status_code 500, rpc.grpc.status_code 13). The traced call chain shows checkout PlaceOrder failing with 'shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500', and inside shipping the /get-quote server span fails with its outbound client span 'POST ' reporting 'Http(http::Error(InvalidUri(InvalidFormat)))' — the destination URI could not be built, so no downstream response is consistent with that span. shipping's Deployment pod template carries env QUOTE_ADDR="quote:0000" while the quote Deployment uses QUOTE_PORT 8080 and the quote Service exposes port 8080. A new shipping ReplicaSet (shipping-5ffdc77bc8) was created at 19:27:31 and its pod started at 19:27:38, i.e. a config rollout immediately before the error onset; the pod is Running/ready with 0 restarts and only logs 'Requesting quote', so this is not a crash. quote and email show no error-status spans of their own and their request volume fell to 0 after ~19:30, consistent with being bypassed by the broken call, not with being the cause. Root cause: Deployment otel-demo/shipping (env QUOTE_ADDR=quote:0000). Who or what changed that value at 19:27:31 is not observable because change history is not integrated.

claims.text: frontend error-status span rate was 0 at every sampled minute from 18:30:51 through 19:27:51 (status_code=STATUS_CODE_ERROR), then became 0.71/s at 19:28:51 and stayed between ~1.47 and ~2.07/s at the non-gap sampled minutes up to 19:39:51, matching the alert start time 2026-11-17T19:28:51Z.

In 19:20:33-19:42:33 the error-status span increases were: frontend 'POST /api/checkout', 'POST', 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' and 'grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' each ~429.8; checkout 'HTTP POST' and 'oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' each ~425.3; shipping '/get-quote' and 'POST ' each ~426.3; frontend-proxy 'ingress' ~446.1 and 'router frontend egress' ~429.8. No error-status series was returned for quote, email, product-catalog or currency in that query.

Trace 626562e79f7e4ed8e6c1bb394758573c (19:38:06-19:38:07) shows the failure path with exact texts: frontend POST /api/checkout http.status_code=500 error=true; frontend grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder error with '13 INTERNAL: shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500'; checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder error with otel.status_description 'shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500' and rpc.grpc.status_code 13; checkout 'HTTP POST' error=true; shipping '/get-quote' error with otel.status_description 'Internal Server Error'; shipping child client span 'POST ' error with otel.status_description 'Http(http::Error(InvalidUri(InvalidFormat)))'.

The shipping Deployment's container env contains QUOTE_ADDR="quote:0000" (its other vars are OTEL_*/SHIPPING_PORT=8080). In the same read, the quote Deployment's env contains QUOTE_PORT=8080 with containerPort 8080, and the quote Service exposes port 8080/targetPort 8080.

Kubernetes events in namespace otel-demo show a shipping rollout: Deployment shipping 'Scaled up replica set shipping-5ffdc77bc8 from 0 to 1' at 19:27:31, ReplicaSet shipping-5ffdc77bc8 SuccessfulCreate (pod shipping-5ffdc77bc8-755zn) at 19:27:31, Pod Scheduled 19:27:31 and Started 19:27:38, and Deployment shipping 'Scaled down replica set shipping-75d58f5d84 from 1 to 0' plus Pod shipping-75d58f5d84-gw77q Killing and ReplicaSet shipping-75d58f5d84 SuccessfulDelete at 19:27:38 — a pod-template change, not a pod crash.

The current shipping pod shipping-5ffdc77bc8-755zn is Running with restartCount 0 (startTime 19:27:31Z) and the shipping Deployment reports ready=1, so the serving pod is up and ready while still failing its quote calls.

shipping-5ffdc77bc8-755zn logs contain 6 startup lines at 19:27:39 ('Shipping service is running', 'starting service: "actix-web-service-0.0.0.0:8080"') and 333 'Requesting quote' lines with no error/failure log lines, so the failures surface only in its spans, not as container crashes or restarts.

Request volume into quote and email collapsed after the shipping rollout: quote span increase fell from 68 at 19:29:00 to 0 from 19:30:00 onward and email from 90.67 at 19:29:00 to 0 from 19:30:00 onward, while shipping kept a similar total span rate (~101-140 per 2m) that was now made up of error spans.

Before the deviation (window 18:30:00-19:20:00), frontend error-status increases were 0 for every frontend operation including POST /api/checkout and grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, and checkout had no error-status series, while small pre-existing background existed: ad and fraud-detection 'flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream' ~1.05 each, recommendation '/flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream' ~2.07, and frontend-proxy 'ingress' ~14.53 per 50m.

The flagd-config ConfigMap (demo.flagd.json), read at 19:43:11, declares every fault-injection flag (adFailure, adHighCpu, adManualGc, cartFailure, emailMemoryLeak, imageSlowLoad, kafkaQueueProblems, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage, paymentFailure, paymentUnreachable, productCatalogFailure, recommendationCacheFailure) with defaultVariant "off"; this describes the ConfigMap's current content only, not its content at 19:27.

Hypothesis that the quote service itself was failing: rejected, because quote produced no ERROR-status spans in the 19:20:33-19:42:33 breakdown, its spans carried no error signal while its traffic simply dropped to 0 from 19:30:00, and the observed shipping failure is a client span whose URI could not even be constructed (InvalidUri(InvalidFormat)), which precedes any call to quote.

Hypothesis that an injection flag (e.g. cartFailure/adFailure/paymentFailure) caused the errors: rejected as far as it can be checked, because all flagd flags read as defaultVariant "off" at 19:43:11 and the error spans are confined to the frontend->checkout->shipping quote path, with 0 error increases for cart, currency, product-catalog and payment in the incident breakdown; the flag values in effect at 19:27 remain unverified.

Hypothesis that frontend failed independently of checkout (e.g. on read routes or image loading): rejected, because frontend error increases for 'GET', 'GET /api/cart', 'GET /api/data' and 'grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' were 0 while all frontend errors were on POST/POST /api/checkout/'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout'/grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder.

The cause is the shipping Deployment's pod template value QUOTE_ADDR="quote:0000": it does not match the quote Service/Deployment port 8080, shipping's failing outbound 'POST ' span reports 'Http(http::Error(InvalidUri(InvalidFormat)))' (a malformed destination URI rather than a downstream response), and the error onset at 19:28:51 follows the new shipping ReplicaSet shipping-5ffdc77bc8 created at 19:27:31 with the pod started at 19:27:38.

Set the shipping Deployment's QUOTE_ADDR to the address the quote Service actually exposes (quote:8080) and roll the Deployment, then confirm shipping '/get-quote' spans stop erroring and checkout PlaceOrder / frontend POST /api/checkout return 200.

Retrieve change/audit history (the change_history integration is not available in this Run) for Deployment otel-demo/shipping around 19:27:31 to identify who or what set QUOTE_ADDR=quote:0000, and add a pre-rollout check that shipping dependency addresses match the corresponding Service ports.

gaps: Change history is not integrated (data_sources.not_integrated contains change_history): it is unknown who or what changed shipping's QUOTE_ADDR to "quote:0000" and exactly when; the earliest observed evidence of the change is the new ReplicaSet shipping-5ffdc77bc8 created at 2026-11-17T19:27:31Z.

The pre-rollout shipping pod shipping-75d58f5d84-gw77q no longer exists and its logs/environment are unreadable, so its QUOTE_ADDR value and whether it was already failing cannot be checked (fetch_pod_logs reported no previous container instance for the current pod).

The email pod's application logs returned no lines for the window (fetch_pod_logs on email-59f69bc6cf-zwpwn, with and without an error filter, returned status no_data with 0 lines read), so whether email ever answered with HTTP 500 — as the checkout status description 'failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500' states — could not be verified; email's own error-status spans were never returned, but a series that is not returned is unknown, not zero.

Queries kube_replicaset_owner{namespace="otel-demo",owner_name="shipping"} and kube_pod_container_info{namespace="otel-demo",pod=~"shipping.*"} returned no series at 19:42:00, so the image-digest comparison for this config-only rollout could not be verified from kube-state-metrics.

list_prometheus_rules with rule_name=RequestErrorRate returned no data, so the alert rule's exact expression, threshold and evaluation window were not verified; only the Alertmanager labels/annotations (service_name=frontend, current 1.7777...) were supplied.

The frontend error-rate series has gap minutes where ERROR and UNSET values are simultaneously 0 (e.g. 19:37:51, 19:38:51 and the last point 19:40:51), so it is unknown whether the alert is still firing after 19:39:51.
Trace data is a sampled view (233 spans matched per service query), so the chain is shown for the traces examined and is not a complete request count or full call graph.
next_steps: Have a human verify the shipping Deployment manifest (env QUOTE_ADDR) against the quote Service port 8080 and correct it to quote:8080, then redeploy.
Pull audit/change history for Deployment otel-demo/shipping around 2026-11-17T19:27:31Z to find the actor that changed QUOTE_ADDR.
Inspect the email service's stdout/stderr directly on its node or via a working log pipeline to confirm whether it ever returned 500s in the window.
Confirm the alert's Prometheus rule definition (name RequestErrorRate) and whether it is still firing now.
